subject: Pulse rotor: next steps & rotating demo cadence (tech deep-dive)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ami Patel <ami@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pulse rotor: next steps & rotating demo cadence (tech deep-dive)

Hi Ami —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — great to learn more about Neurolytics' inference scale and the multi-region deployment constraints you mentioned. Quick recap from our side:

- Goals: reduce per-token cost on inference-heavy batch scoring, keep sub-200ms 95th pct for customer-facing endpoints, and standardize model rollout across us/eu/apac.
- Constraints: SOC2 controls, private VPC routing for EU data, and a dedicated staging pool for model validation.
- Next step you agreed to: technical deep-dive + architecture walk where we bring runtime engineers.

To make scheduling simple across your global team, we sketched a rotating cadence that covers US-, EU-, and APAC-friendly windows on a repeating 3-week cycle. Attached is a compact matrix (timezone-cadence.xlsx) and our discovery notes. High level proposal:

Option A — 3-week rotating windows (recommended)
- Week 1: US-friendly slot — Mon/Wed 10:00–11:30 PT (covers NA mornings)
- Week 2: EU-friendly slot — Tue/Thu 14:00–15:30 CET (covers EU afternoons)
- Week 3: APAC-friendly slot — Wed/Fri 10:00–11:30 SGT (covers APAC mornings)

Option B — Fixed weekly with alternating invitees (if you prefer fewer schedule changes)

If Option A looks reasonable, we can seed recurring invites that rotate the time every week (so different stakeholders join when it’s their regional window). Please: 1) confirm which option you prefer, 2) share the minimal attendee list for each session (we assume: Ami + 1 ML lead + 1 DevOps), and 3) indicate any blackout dates (platform upgrade windows, vacations).

I’ve included a short Calendly link if you’d rather pick a first session directly: https://calendly.com/sofia-redwood/tech-deep-dive-60

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), timezone-cadence.xlsx (rotation matrix)

Thanks — will loop Ben (runtime lead) and Karthik (sales engineer) into the first deep-dive so we can jump into kernels, quantization strategy, and network egress patterns.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova

A few quick notes from the Neurolytics side:
- Attendees for initial session: Ami Patel (me), Ravi Menon (ML Lead), and our on-call DevOps engineer (I cc’ed the DevOps alias above).
- Week of June 2 is generally clear for our team.
- Can you make the first session a US-friendly window so the NA product team can sit in? If possible: Mon, 2025-06-02 at 10:00 PT works for us.
- Blackouts: June 9–11 we have an internal cloud migration; avoid those dates.

If you can seed the invite for June 2 at 10:00 PT, we’ll confirm attendees and share any architecture docs ahead of time. I’ll also add an internal calendar note so Ravi can pull logs and sample traces.

–Ami
